prompts.prompt:
Create a 60-second premium cinematic short film titled “THE PAPER BOAT.”

STYLE:
Photorealistic live-action cinematic realism, emotionally restrained, award-winning short-film cinematography, premium theatrical production quality, natural performances, physically accurate environments, realistic water simulation, authentic atmospheric perspective, subtle film grain, natural HDR, realistic lens behavior, no artificial CGI appearance.
CORE CONCEPT:
The entire film follows one ordinary handmade paper boat on an impossible journey. There is exactly ONE impossible element in the world: this small paper boat can travel wherever connected water flows, no matter how far. Everything else obeys real-world physics.

The audience should initially believe they are watching an ordinary child's paper boat experiment. Only gradually should the journey become extraordinary.
CHARACTER 1:
A quiet 9-year-old South Asian boy with warm medium-brown skin, expressive dark eyes, slightly messy short black hair, slim build, wearing a faded mustard-yellow T-shirt, worn blue shorts and simple sandals. His appearance, clothing, hairstyle, proportions and facial identity remain perfectly consistent whenever he appears.

CHARACTER 2:
An elderly South Asian man around 70 years old, weathered expressive face, silver hair, simple cream shirt, dark trousers and worn sandals. Natural elderly movement, subtle expressions, realistic skin and hair.

THE PAPER BOAT:
One tiny handmade white paper boat folded from slightly creased school notebook paper. Imperfect folds, tiny graphite pencil marks and one faint blue crayon line on one side. It is ordinary paper, not magical-looking. No glow, no symbols, no supernatural appearance. The exact same boat must remain visually recognizable throughout the entire film, becoming slightly damp and worn during its journey.
STORY AND CAMERA:

0–5 SECONDS — THE HOOK
Extreme macro close-up with an 85mm macro lens.

A tiny handmade paper boat floats perfectly still inside a shallow rain puddle after a monsoon shower.
Raindrops strike the water around it.

One large raindrop lands directly inside the boat.

The boat rocks dangerously.

For a moment it looks like it will sink.

Instead, it rights itself.

Rack focus from the rippling water to the boy's reflection in the puddle.

The boy is crouched beside it, silently watching.

Natural breathing, blinking and tiny eye movement.

5–10 SECONDS

Low 35mm tracking shot beside the boy.

He gently pushes the boat forward with one fingertip.

He gives a tiny, genuine smile and quietly whispers:

“Ja... dekhte hain kahan jaati hai.”

Natural child delivery, soft voice, tiny pause between words, no theatrical acting.

The boat begins drifting through a thin stream of rainwater running along the street.

The boy follows it.

His sandals splash naturally through shallow water.

His shirt moves with his running.

Small droplets strike the camera lens.

10–18 SECONDS

The camera drops almost to water level and begins following the paper boat.

The boat enters a narrow concrete drainage channel.

The boy runs alongside it for a few seconds before stopping.

His expression changes from excitement to concern as the boat disappears into the channel.

The camera does NOT cut.

It continues following the boat through the drainage channel.

The narrow concrete environment gradually becomes a larger natural stream.

Use foreground leaves, flowing water and a curtain of dripping vegetation to create a seamless hidden transition.

No teleportation.

No magical transformation.

18–26 SECONDS

The stream becomes a wide river.

The camera slowly rises from water level into a graceful crane movement.

Reveal an enormous realistic river surrounded by countryside.

The tiny paper boat remains the visual anchor.

Warm sunlight begins breaking through clouds.

Wet vegetation glistens.

Birds move naturally through the distant sky.

The boy is now barely visible far behind on the riverbank.

The boat is carried faster by the current.

26–34 SECONDS

The river becomes progressively wider.

The camera remains physically connected to the boat, tracking its movement naturally.

The landscape gradually changes as the river approaches the coast.

The boat enters increasingly turbulent water.

Realistic ripples, foam, reflections and paper deformation.

The camera passes behind a large foreground tree trunk, creating a natural dark-frame transition.

When the camera emerges, the river has reached the ocean.

Reveal a vast open sea.

The tiny boat floats into the enormous expanse.

34–42 SECONDS

The camera tracks directly behind the paper boat at water level.

Ocean waves gently lift and lower it.

The boat is now slightly damp and softened but remains intact and recognizable.

Subtle environmental progression communicates distance and time:

changing cloud formations,
changing sunlight,
changing ocean conditions,
different coastlines appearing and disappearing in the distance.

Use wave spray and foreground water to conceal seamless environmental transitions.

No artificial time-lapse.

No teleportation.

Everything remains physically believable except the boat's impossible ability to continue traveling.

Seabirds occasionally cross the frame.
One bird briefly skims the ocean surface near the boat.
42–48 SECONDS
The ocean gradually approaches a quiet rocky coastline.

The camera moves from behind the boat into a graceful side profile.

A gentle wave carries the boat toward a narrow natural channel leading into a peaceful inland lake.

The soundscape becomes quieter.

The boat enters the lake.

Late-afternoon sunlight now creates warm natural reflections across the water.

Reveal the elderly South Asian man sitting alone beside the lake, sketching quietly in a small notebook.

He hears the water.

He looks up.

48–54 SECONDS

50mm medium close-up.

The elderly man notices the tiny paper boat approaching the shore.

He doesn't react dramatically.

First curiosity.

Then confusion.

Then recognition.

His breathing pauses for a moment.

His eyes soften.

He slowly stands.

The boat gently touches his sandal.

He bends down and carefully picks it up using both hands.

He examines the tiny graphite marks and faint blue crayon line.

A quiet emotional smile appears.

No dialogue.

The emotion must be communicated entirely through micro-expression, eye movement, breathing and body language.

54–60 SECONDS — EMOTIONAL CALLBACK

The elderly man takes a fresh sheet of paper from his notebook.

He begins folding a new paper boat.

Close-up on his hands.

His fingers make the first fold.

MATCH CUT:

The exact same hand movement becomes the 9-year-old boy's hands from the opening scene.

The boy is back beside the original rain puddle.

He places another handmade paper boat onto the water.

The new boat begins drifting.

The camera slowly pulls backward.

The puddle reflects the sky.

The reflection gradually fills the frame.

The reflection visually resembles the enormous lake where the elderly man was sitting.

Hold for one quiet beat.

CUT TO BLACK.

CINEMATOGRAPHY:
Professional theatrical cinematography throughout. 35mm and 50mm cinema lenses for narrative shots, 85mm macro for intimate details, natural depth of field, subtle lens breathing, realistic focus pulls, physically motivated camera movement, restrained handheld micro-movement around the child, smooth stabilized tracking around the boat, gradual crane and aerial reveals only when motivated by geography.

The camera must always feel physically present in the environment.

No impossible camera movement.

No random drone shots.

Every camera movement must reveal geography, emotion or scale.

LIGHTING:
Begin with cool, soft post-rain daylight.

Gradually transition into warm sunlight as the boat reaches the river.

Move naturally toward late-afternoon golden light when the elderly man discovers the boat.

Maintain physically consistent shadows, reflections and exposure throughout.
ENVIRONMENTAL REALISM:
Wet concrete, puddles, water droplets, muddy edges, paper fibers, damp clothing, realistic reflections, atmospheric haze, leaves reacting to wind, grass bending naturally, birds responding to the environment, subtle dust and moisture in sunlight, realistic ocean spray, accurate water interaction, natural cloth movement and hair movement.

AUDIO:
Primarily natural diegetic sound.

Rain droplets.
Flowing water.
Footsteps.
Child's breathing.
Distant traffic.
Birds.
Wind.
River current.
Ocean waves.
Paper folding.

Use a restrained cinematic score that gradually builds as the journey expands, then becomes almost silent when the elderly man discovers the boat.

No dialogue after the boy's single sentence.

EMOTIONAL ARC:
Curiosity → excitement → uncertainty → wonder → vastness → quiet discovery → emotional connection → circular beginning.
The film must NOT explain who the elderly man is or why the boat reached him.

Let the audience interpret the connection.

VISUAL RULE:
Everything in the film must look completely real except for the single impossible rule governing the paper boat.

NO:
dragons,
magic particles,
glowing objects,
portals,
fantasy environments,
cyberpunk,
giant objects,
supernatural effects,
text,
subtitles,
logos,
watermarks,
exaggerated acting,
cartoon physics,
unmotivated camera movement,
teleportation,
morphing characters,
duplicate boats,
changing boat design,
character inconsistency,
artificial-looking CGI.

FINAL FEELING:
The film should feel like a real cinematic short that quietly contains one impossible event.
The viewer should finish with the feeling:

“Wait... how did that paper boat get there?”

Then the final image should make them want to watch the entire journey again.

VISUAL PRIORITY:
Photorealism > spectacle.
Emotion > exposition.
Physics > VFX.
Story > technical demonstration.
Subtlety > exaggeration.
Make every frame feel intentionally photographed by a world-class cinematographer rather than generated by an AI model.

Anne Boleyn’s final walk.
For this test, I recreated the moment Anne is led toward the scaffold —building the emotion through performance, blocking, camera direction, atmosphere, and sound rather than showing graphic violence.

What makes Seedance 2.5 feel like a real upgrade is control: more characters, videos, and audios references in the same generation, supports up to 30 seconds in a single pass, and is designed for continuous storytelling rather than isolated shots. That means more room to preserve identity, emotional progression and spatial continuity.

But more capability also means more decisions. A vague prompt can still produce a beautiful clip with the wrong character, the wrong action order, or a broken transition. That’s why I created the Seedance 2.5 Prompter: it turns a scene idea into the right Seedance workflow—mapping every reference, defining what must stay consistent, structuring the action, and writing the camera and audio direction clearly.

The Seedance 2.5 PROMPTER turns your scripts and ideas into flawless, copy-ready video prompts — built on the official guide, not outdated templates.

Less guessing. Fewer wasted generations. More intentional storytelling. 🎬

prompts.prompt:
时长：30秒
画幅：16:9
语言：自然美式英语
声音：演员现场原声，精准口型同步；无旁白、无字幕、无背景音乐
影像：高端欧美现实主义爱情电影质感，克制、冷峻、浅景深，真实皮肤纹理，摄影机运动极轻微
人物均为原创虚构角色，不参考任何演员、名人或影视作品。
【人物设定】
男方 NOAH：28岁，英俊、身材挺拔，深棕色短发，白衬衫袖口卷起。他怀疑女友爱上了一个更富有的男人。表面愤怒，实际害怕自己不值得被爱。
女方 CLAIRE：26岁，漂亮、气质冷静，金棕色长发，黑色简约连衣裙。她确实曾被另一个男人吸引，但真正动摇她的不是金钱，而是长期被男友忽视。
全程保持两人脸部、发型、服装、声线和空间位置一致。
【核心情绪曲线】
怀疑压制 → 讽刺防御 → 直接逼问 → 短暂坦白 → 男方受伤 → 女方说出关系早已结束的真相。
两个人不是从第一秒就大吼。真正的情绪峰值出现在女方说出：
“No. But I wanted to.”
最终一刀则是：
“We just kept calling it love.”
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【镜头一｜0.0—7.0秒】
双人中近景。NOAH站在前景，CLAIRE站在几步之外。摄影机缓慢向两人靠近。
0.0—2.4秒
NOAH的目的：逼她主动承认。
他先盯着她沉默半秒，嘴唇压紧，下颌轻微咬住。眉毛向内下压，眼睑收紧，但音量保持克制，不要立刻咆哮。
他缓慢说道：
“Tell me the truth. Is it him?”
“truth”略微加重；说到“him”时才抬起眼睛直视她。
说完后保持静止，不提前流泪，不移开视线。
2.4—4.4秒
CLAIRE的目的：用讽刺挡住羞耻。
她没有立即回答。鼻腔短促呼气，嘴角出现不足一秒的苦涩微笑，目光扫过他的衬衫，然后重新看回他的眼睛。
她轻声反问：
“You mean the man with the car?”
“car”没有炫耀意味，而是故意刺中他的自卑。
说完后笑意立刻消失。身体没有后退。
4.4—7.0秒
NOAH被刺中，眉间压力增强，向前走半步，但不触碰她。
声音第一次抬高：
“Don’t make this a joke. I saw you leave with him.”
“saw”短促加重；最后的“him”压低声音，像在努力控制失态。
CLAIRE听他说话时不翻白眼、不抢话。她的眼神短暂变软，随后重新封闭。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【镜头二｜7.0—20.0秒】
切到CLAIRE肩后拍NOAH，再缓慢转为两人的交替近景。
7.0—9.3秒
CLAIRE的目的：让他明白“离开”和“背叛”不是同一件事。
她停顿半秒，平静说道：
“And I came home.”
语速慢，音量低。“home”说得很轻，像提醒他自己曾经选择回来。
她说完后等待他的反应，不继续解释。
9.3—12.0秒
NOAH的愤怒开始失去保护作用。
他的嘴唇张开，却有半秒没有声音。目光从她的眼睛移到嘴唇，又迅速回到眼睛。胸口出现一次明显但受控的吸气。
他问：
“Did you kiss him?”
不要吼叫。声音比前面更轻、更不稳定，像他真正害怕听见答案。
12.0—16.0秒
CLAIRE先保持眼神接触一秒。
她回答第一个词：
“No.”
停顿约0.8秒。她的目光第一次落下，嘴角轻微绷紧；再次抬眼时，攻击性完全消失。
随后坦白：
“But I wanted to.”
“wanted”说得很轻，不能喊。声音尾部出现轻微气息断裂，但不哭。
这是全片最重要的转折。NOAH听到“wanted”后才出现反应：眼睑轻微抬起，下颌松开，身体像失去支撑一样后移半步。反应不能提前。
16.0—20.0秒
NOAH试图用金钱解释这一切，重新保护自尊。
他短促吸气，眉毛向内收紧，声音突然抬高一次：
“Because he can give you everything?”
“everything”达到男方全片最高音量，随后立即降下来。
说完后他闭紧嘴唇，眼神已经不再愤怒，而是在等待一次能够拯救自己的否认。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【镜头三｜20.0—30.0秒】
CLAIRE面部特写，随后轻微转焦到她身后的NOAH。摄影机保持克制，不环绕、不快速推进。
20.0—23.2秒
CLAIRE终于说出真正原因。
她的眉毛内侧轻微抬起，眼眶开始湿润，但眼泪不能落下。下巴轻微绷紧，呼吸变浅。
她直视他说：
“Because he listened when I spoke.”
“listened”轻微加重；“spoke”几乎成为耳语。
这句话不是报复，而是她已经疲惫到不想再争辩。
23.2—25.0秒
NOAH所有攻击性消失。
肩膀下降，目光短暂离开她。他想说更多，却只能低声问：
“So that’s it?”
“it”尾音轻微发虚。不要哭，不要做夸张痛苦表情。
25.0—30.0秒
CLAIRE轻轻摇头一次。
她先说：
“No.”
停顿0.6秒，像是在决定是否还要给这段关系留下体面。
随后平静说道：
“It ended months ago. We just kept calling it love.”
“ended”保持冷静；说到“love”时声音第一次轻微破裂。
最后一个词结束后，她仍然直视他约1秒。眼泪停留在下眼睑，不落下来。随后她缓慢移开目光。
NOAH站在失焦背景中，没有追上去，也没有说话。
结尾保持两人之间的静止和距离至少1秒，不恢复中性表情，不增加额外对白。
【表演限制】
- 不要从第一秒开始吼叫或哭泣。
- CLAIRE在20秒前眼眶不能明显湿润，全程不连续流泪。
- NOAH的核心不是暴怒，而是用愤怒掩盖自卑和恐惧。
- CLAIRE不是冷酷反派，她是在承认一段关系早已被忽视耗尽。
- 所有停顿都有心理行动，避免机械停顿。
- 手势克制，不摔东西、不推搡、不发生身体冲突。
- 保留准确英文对白、角色分配、自然呼吸和精准口型。
NEGATIVE:
subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, background music, theatrical overacting,
constant shouting, premature tears, instant emotional switch, random gestures,
physical violence, frozen listener, robotic delivery, lip-sync drift, double mouth,
warped face, extra fingers, identity drift, wardrobe drift, abrupt camera movement

prompts.prompt:
CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm **vertical 9:16** daily vlog footage optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. The video MUST begin with her holding the camera at arm's length in selfie mode, speaking directly to the lens while casually walking through the gym. The framing stays vertical throughout, with natural selfie composition, occasional head cropping, imperfect framing, and realistic phone-like movement. The first 20–30 seconds are entirely handheld. Only later does she occasionally place the camera on a dumbbell rack, adjustable bench, stretching mat, gym bag, or water bottle for wider vertical shots. Keep subtle handheld shake, drifting composition, autofocus hunting, rushed reframing, uneven zooms, exposure breathing, brief accidental face cropping, and imperfect framing throughout. The camera itself is never visible.

LOOK: Warm analog tape texture with gentle film grain, slightly softened sharpness, subtle halation around overhead lights, realistic skin tones, low contrast, tiny exposure shifts, and natural motion blur. The footage should feel authentic and completely unstaged, like a real creator documenting her workout on her phone.

STYLE: An intimate daily fitness vlog filmed in a mostly empty boutique gym. Casual, relaxed, and conversational. Small laughs, pauses, fixing her ponytail, wiping sweat with her towel, catching her breath, looking away while thinking, and talking naturally to the audience instead of delivering lines. She speaks in short, natural sentences with frequent pauses. Never rush dialogue. Leave quiet moments between lines.

CHARACTER: A beautiful white blonde fitness creator in her early 20s. Long blonde hair tied into a loose ponytail, blue eyes, glowing skin, and a slim athletic figure. She wears a fitted black long-sleeve workout top, high-waisted black leggings, white socks, white sneakers, and a white towel loosely resting around her neck.

SETTING: A modern boutique gym late in the evening. Dumbbell racks, kettlebells, medicine balls, mirrors, benches, stretching mats, resistance bands, a gym bag, shaker bottle, and warm overhead lighting. The gym is almost empty with only one or two people blurred in the distant background.

SCENES:

The vlog opens in selfie mode. She is holding the camera at arm's length while slowly walking through the dumbbell area, smiling naturally.
"...okay."
"I definitely earned dinner."
She laughs quietly and adjusts the towel around her neck.
"I almost skipped today."
She briefly turns the camera toward the nearly empty gym before pointing it back at herself.
"Glad I came."
Still holding the camera, she walks toward the stretching area.
"My legs are done."
She places the camera on a nearby bench for a wider vertical angle and sits down on a stretching mat.
She stretches one leg and takes a deep breath.
"I really need to stretch more."
She smiles to herself.
She switches sides and rolls one shoulder.
"Tomorrow's gonna hurt."
She picks the camera back up and walks toward her gym bag.
She kneels beside it, pulls out a protein shake, and takes a sip.
"...that's actually good."
She laughs.
The camera sits on top of the gym bag while she packs away her towel, headphones, and lifting straps.
"Worth it."
She throws the bag over one shoulder and picks the camera back up.
Walking toward the exit in selfie mode, she smiles into the lens.
"See you next workout."
She gives the camera a small wave before ending the recording.

prompts.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic travel vlog featuring the same young woman throughout the entire sequence. Maintain identical facial features, hairstyle, makeup, skin tone, body proportions, and outfit consistency unless naturally changed during the journey. Premium lifestyle cinematography, luxury airport aesthetic, authentic travel atmosphere, smooth handheld and gimbal camera movement, realistic body language, 4K HDR, 16:9.

The video opens with a close-up of her smiling into the camera in her bedroom beside an open suitcase. She finishes a light makeup routine, zips her luggage, picks up her passport, and says, "New adventure... let's go!" She leaves home, loads her suitcase into a cab, and films the city through the window while saying, "On the way to the airport."

She arrives at the airport, checks the departure board, checks in her luggage, clears security, browses duty-free stores, grabs a coffee, and smiles at the camera saying, "Boarding starts in a few minutes." She walks through the boarding gate, enters the aircraft, settles into her window seat, watches planes outside, and says, "Ready for takeoff!"

During the flight, she enjoys a beautifully served meal, records the tray, takes a bite, and says, "The lunch is actually delicious." She watches the clouds through the window, reads a magazine, and relaxes before the aircraft lands.

After arrival, she exits the airport, waves at the camera, gets into another cab, and says, "Made it to a new country!" The cab passes famous city landmarks before reaching a luxury hotel. She checks in, enters her room, opens the curtains to reveal the skyline, freshens up with a quick skincare and light makeup routine, changes into comfortable sleepwear, smiles at the camera saying, "Time to rest... tomorrow the real adventure begins." She switches off the bedside lamp as the camera slowly pulls back.

Ultra-realistic travel cinematography, authentic airport ambience, realistic announcements, rolling suitcase sounds, aircraft cabin atmosphere, soft background music, premium hotel interiors, cinematic lighting, natural facial expressions, smooth transitions, shallow depth of field, luxury commercial quality, no subtitles, no logos, no watermarks, no on-screen text.

prompts.prompt:
Create an exactly 15-second photorealistic shopping vlog in 16:9: extremely sharp 4K compact-camera detail, natural HDR, accurate skin, realistic motion and perfect identity continuity. No VHS, grain, subtitles, logos, watermarks or graphics.

SUBJECT: A 21-year-old American woman with long wavy chestnut hair, light everyday makeup and an expressive, approachable face. Fitted black long-sleeve top, light-blue straight jeans, sneakers and a small black shoulder bag. Keep her face, hair, outfit, bag and jewellery identical through every cut. She talks like a normal friend, never a presenter.

STORE: A large modern high-street womenswear shop resembling an upscale European fast-fashion retailer without real branding. Cream walls, black fixtures, mirrors, warm-neutral spotlights, polished floor, fitting rooms, folded denim and dense racks of blazers, tops, dresses, knitwear and trousers. Adult shoppers browse independently. No readable brands, signs, price tags or labels.

CAMERA: The same compact camera stays in her hand throughout. Every frame is one-handed arm’s-length selfie, her mirror reflection holding it, or her rotating it outward to show clothes. Never place it down, prop it up, pass it to anyone or use an external angle. Sharp 20–24mm-equivalent wide lens, mild barrel distortion, deep focus, reliable eye autofocus and true 24fps with 1/48-second blur. Stabilization controls impacts but retains footstep bob, wrist sway, breathing, grip shifts, late pans and imperfect reframing. Preserve pores, flyaways, teeth, fabric and accurate reflections without beauty filtering or fake bokeh. Exposure stays face-priority but shifts subtly between mirrored aisles and the fitting-room corridor. Fast wrist turns show slight rolling-shutter skew and natural background blur while her face and garments remain sharply resolved.

EDITING IS CRITICAL: Use 12 clips and 11 hard jump cuts. Most cuts remain in the same aisle or beside the same rack, with only a small jump in pose, expression, camera distance, garment position or sentence. Remove mundane pauses and bits of walking. Cut mid-gesture, during camera turns and inside sentences for the fast rhythm of an edited social vlog. Geography and identity stay coherent despite time compression. No fades, transitions, whip effects or cinematic montage. Cuts are not beat-synced; some happen for no narrative reason and simply skip a fraction of an ordinary action.

CLIP 1 — 0.0–1.2:

Walking into the store in loose selfie framing:

“Okay, I’m literally just getting—”

CLIP 2 — 1.2–2.3:

Jump cut a few steps inside, nearly the same angle but her hair and bag have shifted:

“—one top. That’s it.”

CLIP 3 — 2.3–3.4:

She rotates the camera toward a crowded rack and slides hangers with her free hand. Hangers clack; no dialogue.

CLIP 4 — 3.4–4.6:

Jump cut beside the same rack. In selfie view she holds a dark-red top against herself:

“Wait, this is cute.”

CLIP 5 — 4.6–5.5:

Cut to a nearby mirror, camera visible in her hand. She checks the top. Her female friend, mostly off-camera, says, “No.” She turns: “Really?”

CLIP 6 — 5.5–6.4:

Close selfie micro-cut in the same spot. She laughs:

“Okay, rude.”

CLIP 7 — 6.4–7.6:

She rotates toward a blazer rail and pulls out a charcoal jacket. Focus briefly transfers from mirror to fabric.

CLIP 8 — 7.6–8.8:

Jump cut in the same aisle. The top and jacket now rest over her free arm. Looking down:

“Why do I already have four things?”

CLIP 9 — 8.8–9.8:

Near-identical angle after another micro-cut. Friend: “Because you picked them up.” She smiles: “Fair.”

CLIP 10 — 9.8–11.2:

Cut to her walking past another rack. She pans across dresses, passes the item she wants, then corrects back. No dialogue.

CLIP 11 — 11.2–13.2:

Mirror near the fitting rooms. Holding the jacket against herself:

“Do I need this?”

Friend: “No.” She smiles, ignoring the answer.

CLIP 12 — 13.2–15.0:

Close walking selfie approaching the fitting rooms, garments over her free arm:

“Okay, I’m trying it on.”

prompts.prompt:
CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm daily vlog footage. The video MUST begin with her holding the camera at arm's length in selfie mode while stepping outside her apartment building with her dog. The first 20–30 seconds are entirely handheld. Later she occasionally places the camera on a park bench, low stone wall, picnic table, or the ground for wider shots. Keep subtle handheld shake, drifting composition, autofocus hunting, rushed reframing, uneven zooms, exposure breathing, brief accidental face cropping, and imperfect framing throughout. The camera itself is never visible.

LOOK: Warm analog tape texture with gentle film grain, slightly softened sharpness, subtle halation around sunlight, realistic skin tones, low contrast, tiny exposure shifts, and natural motion blur. It should feel like authentic footage from someone's everyday life rather than a polished commercial.

STYLE: A relaxed morning lifestyle vlog. Quiet, cozy, and spontaneous. She occasionally laughs at her dog, pauses to look around, adjusts the leash, brushes hair away from her face, and speaks naturally in short sentences with comfortable pauses.

CHARACTER: EMMA — a beautiful white woman in her mid-20s. Long light brown hair in a messy ponytail, green eyes, minimal makeup, oversized gray hoodie, black biker shorts, white sneakers, and a small crossbody bag. She is walking a happy golden retriever.

SETTING: A peaceful suburban neighborhood on a sunny morning. Tree-lined sidewalks, quiet residential streets, birds singing, a small park with benches, green grass, and soft golden morning light. Very few people are around.

SCENES:

The vlog opens in selfie mode. Emma holds the camera while leaving her apartment building with the golden retriever excitedly pulling on the leash.
"Good morning."
She smiles.
"Someone couldn't wait."
The dog eagerly sniffs everything as they walk down the sidewalk.
She laughs quietly.
"He has to inspect every single tree."
Still holding the camera, she walks into a small neighborhood park.
The dog suddenly stops and stares at a squirrel.
"Oh... there we go."
She smiles and gently shakes her head.
She places the camera on a nearby bench for a wider angle while throwing a tennis ball.
The dog happily chases after it.
"Worth waking up early."
She picks the camera back up.
Walking slowly through the park, she looks up at the trees for a moment.
"It's actually really peaceful out here."
The dog returns with the ball but drops it halfway.
She laughs.
"Close enough."
She sits on the bench while the dog lies beside her.
She scratches behind his ears.
"I think he's happier than I am."
She stands up and continues walking.
The camera stays in selfie mode as they head toward home.
"Coffee is definitely next."
She smiles into the lens.
"See you later."
She gives a small wave and ends the recording.

Shot with modern realism and precise temporal control.
Use the provided reference image as the exact character lock for the bald bearded man in black sunglasses and dark hoodie. Maintain perfect facial structure, beard, head shape, skin texture and clothing consistency at all times.
0-5s: [Medium Wide] The bald man walks briskly through the terminal. He turns sharply to check a gate sign and collides hard into a food-cart vendor carrying a full tray of coffee cups, pastries and a thermos. Impact is sudden and physical.
5-12s: [Dynamic Tracking into Super Slow-Motion] Collision detonates. Tray, coffee cups, pastries and thermos explode upward. Coffee erupts into long liquid ribbons and perfect suspended droplets. Camera orbits smoothly around the impact. Time locks completely at the peak of the spill. Every face freezes in pure shock. Only the bald man remains free to move. He freezes for one beat with a clear "I fucked up" expression, then quickly grabs a croissant and a floating coffee cup from the debris.
12-22s: [Tracking Shot] Still inside the frozen terminal, he walks toward the boarding gate while taking deliberate sips of coffee then bites of croissant. All passengers, the vendor and flying food stay perfectly suspended in mid-air.
22-27s: [Medium Shot] Just as he reaches the gate and is about to scan his boarding pass, time snaps back to normal speed. Everything that was floating crashes down at once — cups, pastries, tray and thermos slam onto the floor with a loud chaotic impact. The vendor and passengers react in sudden real-time shock.
27-30s: [Medium Close-Up] He pauses, turns slightly, raises his eyebrows and gives a small casual "it is what it is" shrug with a quiet half-smile of acceptance, still holding the remaining food.

prompts.prompt:
卓球・オリンピック決勝 × カンフー映画の高速バトル

【SUMMARY】
10 seconds, 16:9. The final point of an Olympic table tennis final, shot like a Hong Kong
kung fu duel. Two players, one ball, a dark arena, one column of light on the table.
Real time on every impact, deep slow motion between, one burst of pure hyper-speed.

【SET】
A packed arena, the crowd sunk into near-blackness — silhouettes and tiny out-of-focus
highlights. A hard column of white light falls onto a dark blue table with crisp white
lines. Fine dust drifts inside the beams. Extremely realistic physical texture: paddle
rubber, sweat-soaked fabric, the matte ball. High contrast, deep shadow, hard rim light
from above and behind, shallow depth of field around f/2.0.
A physical LED scoreboard hangs in the darkness behind the table, orange digits reading
10 - 10, sharp and correctly formed, never changing. It is the only lettering in the film.

【PLAYERS — two people, never more】
RED: a 24-year-old East Asian man, lean, heavy shoulders and forearms. Cropped black hair
soaked to his forehead. Sharp narrow eyes, high cheekbones, hard jaw. Cool-toned skin with
real pores, wet with sweat. Plain solid red sleeveless shirt, plain black shorts, no logo
or number. The aggressor.
BLUE: a 26-year-old East Asian man, taller and rangier. Longer black hair pushed back,
dripping. Thick brows, square jaw, steady unblinking stare. Warm-toned skin with real
pores. Plain solid blue sleeveless shirt, plain black shorts, no logo or number. The
counter-puncher.
Neither shows fear: two masters at the end of a long duel, calm and spent. The violence is
in the ball, not their faces.

【TIMELINE】

0.0-2.5s SERVE — deep slow motion.
RED tosses the ball straight up. It climbs through the light, turning slowly, dust around
it. He exhales, drops his shoulder, loads his arm. At 2.2s he strikes: real time snaps in
and the ball tears out of frame.
Camera: low angle just above the table surface, looking up past the net. Locked off.
Audio: near silence — his breath, shoes creaking, a low hush. Then one sharp crack.

2.5-4.3s HYPER-SPEED RALLY — no slow motion at all, the fastest passage in the film.
Fourteen exchanges in under two seconds, faster than any real rally. The ball stops
reading as an object and becomes a white streak cutting a line through the dust. Paddle
arms blur into afterimages, shoulders whip, feet smear. Sweat is thrown off both men in
sheets. The table shudders.
Camera: side-on at net height, one smooth horizontal slide along the table — the camera
stays calm while everything inside the frame is violent.
Audio: the cracks run together into a hard stutter like a drum roll, over squealing shoes
and a rising crowd.

4.3-5.5s THE BREATH — the speed drops out.
One exchange stretched into deep slow motion. RED drives the ball low across the net,
sweat lifting off his forearm and floating, dust turning around the ball. BLUE's eyes
track it. At 5.4s his paddle meets it and real time cracks back in.
Camera: the same side-on slide, now crawling.
Audio: everything falls to a muffled rumble and one long breath, then the crack.

5.5-8.0s THE ANSWER — the deepest slow motion in the film.
BLUE pushes off the floor and leaps sideways, body fully extended, back arched, paddle arm
cocked behind his head. He hangs there. Sweat droplets float around him. Dust turns in the
beam. His eyes lock on the ball. At 7.8s the paddle connects and real time slams back with
the loudest crack yet.
Camera: low angle, looking steeply up at him against the black arena roof. Locked off.
Audio: sound drops muffled and distant while he hangs, then the crack at full volume.

8.0-10.0s THE POINT — real time.
The ball skips off the far corner and away into the dark. RED is caught frozen mid-reach,
unable to follow it. BLUE lands hard, skids on one foot, and roars, head back, fists
clenched. Behind them the crowd erupts, thousands of silhouettes rising at once.
Camera: wide on the table and both men, pushing in 5% at most. Hold to the last frame.
Audio: the crowd explodes, his roar cutting through it, the ball still bouncing underneath.

【RECAP — all 10 seconds】
Dark arena, one hard column of light on the dark blue table, drifting dust, a near-black
crowd of silhouettes.
Only two people in frame. Their faces, hair and clothing stay identical in every shot,
every garment a single solid colour with no logo, number or pattern.
One camera movement per shot, never two. Hard clean cuts on impact. The ball stays inside
the frame at all times.
Real time on every impact, deep slow motion between, switching instantly, with one
sustained hyper-speed burst where the ball is a streak.
The scoreboard reads 10 - 10 and never changes, and it is the only lettering.
The sound is the ball, the shoes, the breathing and the crowd — keep the mix free of music
and commentary.

Flames morph mid-spread into molten glass, then into flowing lava rivers that carve canyons, then into rivers of liquid gold that solidify into ancient temples. The temples crack open under heat, releasing a swarm of phoenix-like firebirds that merge into one colossal bird. The bird dives into the ocean, turning the water into steam and then into a volcanic island that erupts, launching the camera into the stratosphere on a pillar of fire that becomes a rocket trail ending in a silent, glowing ember floating above Earth. Non-stop forward momentum, elemental morphing (fire → glass → lava → gold → birds → volcano), and constant camera chase.

OPERATION: Officer responds first to a small roadside brush fire before firefighters arrive, secures the area, and assists with evacuation of nearby pedestrians.
RESPONDING OFFICER: Male, late 30s. Standard patrol uniform. Chest-mounted body camera. Calm under pressure. Clear verbal commands.
RECORDING WINDOW: 7:10 PM. Warm evening. Streetlights beginning to illuminate.
SCENE LOCATION: Roadside walking trail beside suburban homes. Dry grass. Small trees. Parked vehicles. Fire hydrant nearby.
BODYCAM CHARACTERISTICS: Ultra-wide chest-mounted bodycam. Faster walking and occasional short jog. Noticeable breathing. Frequent head turns scanning surroundings. Hands visible directing pedestrians. No cinematic framing.
INCIDENT FLOW (≈30 Seconds)
Arrival (0–5s)
Officer arrives to find a small patch of dry grass burning with light smoke drifting across the sidewalk.
Safety Response (5–12s)
Officer quickly guides pedestrians away from the smoke, blocks access using patrol vehicle lights, and radios fire department updates.
Activity (12–20s)
Officer checks nearby bushes for fire spread while a resident uses a garden hose to slow the flames from a safe distance.
Fire Department Arrival (20–27s)
Fire engine arrives. Firefighters immediately deploy a hose line and extinguish the remaining flames within seconds.
Departure (27–30s)
Officer confirms the area is secure, thanks nearby residents for staying clear, and returns to patrol duties.
SOUND PROFILE: Radio dispatch, crackling fire, footsteps, distant traffic, sirens approaching, firefighters communicating, hose spraying water.
AUTHENTICITY PROTOCOL: Realistic emergency response. No explosions. No exaggerated heroics. Continuous chest-mounted bodycam perspective with natural movement and authentic scene progression.

prompts.prompt:
纯属虚构的荒诞动作短片。100%真实手机实拍质感，iPhone纪录片风格，30秒手持一镜到底，无剪辑、无转场。自然日光，轻微呼吸式镜头运动，偶发自动对焦迟疑，轻微滚动快门，真实动态模糊，镜头边缘带少量指纹和灰尘。所有变形、机械运动、撞击和碎片效果都必须具有沉重的现实物理反馈，呈现为全尺寸机械装置与实景特效，绝不能出现电子游戏、动画或廉价CG质感。保留现场原始声音和路人的真实反应。 环境 午后，一家繁忙的鸿蒙智行·智界授权汽车门店停车场。 巨大的落地玻璃展厅内停着数辆新车，销售人员正陪顾客看车。停车场车辆进出不断，工作人员拿着平板在车位间穿梭，几名顾客围着一辆停在室外展示区的紫色智界R7拍照。 现场充满城市车流声、轮胎碾过沥青的声音、门店广播、远处交谈声、鸟鸣和偶尔响起的车辆提示音。一切都像路人偶然拍下、即将病毒式传播的手机视频。 门店原有标识可以自然出现在环境中，但不添加字幕、广告标题或浮动文字。 主角 一位二十五岁左右的成年年轻美女
，身材和穿着严格参考
HO2iXF9a4AAZsco
。 她神态放松，右手拿着一个传统竹制发声玩具“竹知了”。竹知了由短竹筒、细绳和小竹片组成。她一边经过停车场，一边漫不经心地转动竹知了。 竹知了发出连续、滑稽而响亮的“呜哇、呜哇”鸣叫声。 她并不是超级英雄，没有盔甲，不发生身体变形，始终保持普通成年女性的真实外貌。 关键车辆 停车场中央只有一辆紫色智界R7发生变形。 必须准确保持紫色车漆、轿跑SUV车身比例、贯穿式前灯、车轮、车门、玻璃和车身覆盖件的视觉连续性。车辆内部无人，没有驾驶员和乘客。 变形过程必须清晰可读：车轮折叠成为肩部结构，车门展开成为前臂护甲，底盘向下延伸形成双腿，车头与贯穿式灯带上升成为胸部，紫色车顶折叠成机器人头部。所有零件均来自同一辆车，不凭空增加零件，不突然更换车型或颜色。 30秒连续镜头 镜头开始于美女右后方约一米半、与肩膀同高的位置。摄影者跟随她缓缓进入停车场，让她的上半身、手里的竹知了以及前方紫色智界R7同时处于画面中。 镜头不能突然飞起，不能切换机位，也不能拉远成为俯瞰全景。 美女一边走，一边悠闲地转动竹知了。连续的“呜哇、呜哇”声在停车场里格外明显。 几名销售人员和顾客好奇地回头看她，但没有人太在意。 突然，紫色智界R7的贯穿式灯带自行亮起。 竹知了每响一声，R7的车灯便同步闪烁一次。 美女逐渐放慢脚步。 智界R7的车身内部传出低沉的金属震动声。悬架猛然下沉，四条轮胎同时摩擦地面，附近车辆的警报器接连响起。 整辆紫色R7突然开始变形。 引擎盖向两侧裂开，车门旋转展开，车轮离开地面并锁入肩部；底盘向下伸展，两条沉重的机械腿砸落在沥青路面上，震出蜘蛛网状裂纹。 紫色智界R7在停车场中央站立起来，变成一台数层楼高的巨型机器人。 停车场瞬间陷入恐慌。 顾客丢下宣传册和咖啡四散奔逃。销售人员钻到展车后面躲避。购物袋、宣传单和遮阳帽被机器人起身产生的气流卷上半空。两辆正在倒车的汽车发生轻微碰撞，喇叭持续鸣响。 机器人发出沉重的机械咆哮，挥动由车门组成的巨大手臂，将停车场的一根灯杆打弯。它随后抬起机械脚掌，踩扁旁边的空置展示台，水泥碎片和灰尘向四周飞散。 摄影者慌张地向后退并侧身躲避，镜头剧烈摇晃。飞来的小块碎片撞在镜头附近，自动对焦短暂失准，然后重新锁定机器人。 镜头迅速回到美女身上。 所有人都在逃跑。 她却几乎没有反应。 她平静地抬头看了看巨型机器人…… ……然后低头看向手里的竹知了。 机器人转过身体，紫色金属脚掌刮过地面，向她迈出沉重的一步。每一步都令停车场地面震动，玻璃展厅随之颤抖。 美女只是轻轻扬起一侧眉毛。 她握紧细绳，突然加快手腕旋转速度。 竹知了的鸣叫声变得越来越急促。 “呜哇——呜哇——呜哇——” 竹筒内部开始透出淡淡的金色光芒。 光芒越来越强。 十个、数百个、成千上万个发光的竹知了在她身体周围凭空出现，像一群完美同步的金色蜂群，在她头顶和肩膀周围高速盘旋。 旋转产生的强风吹动她的长发和衣角，将停车场里的宣传单、树叶、灰尘和塑料袋全部卷入空中。金色光芒映在周围汽车的玻璃与金属车漆上。 巨型机器人挥动紫色机械手臂，试图拍散竹知了群。机械拳头擦过地面，掀起碎石和尘土。 美女侧身迈开一步避过冲击，双脚重新站稳，身体重心压低，右手仍然牢牢控制细绳。 她突然将竹知了高高举起…… ……然后打了一个清脆的响指。 所有发光的竹知了瞬间向前发射。 天空被无数道金色轨迹划破。 第一批竹知了像精准制导的蜂群，猛烈撞击机器人的膝关节和脚踝；第二批绕着机器人高速盘旋，钻入肩部车轮、车门手臂和胸口灯带之间的机械缝隙。 机器人踉跄后退，机械脚掌在沥青上拖出两道深深的沟槽。它挥拳反击，却不断打空，每一次挥动都带起真实而沉重的气流。 最后一批竹知了在机器人胸前汇聚成高速旋转的金色圆环。 美女猛然向下一拉细绳。 所有竹知了同时发出一声震耳欲聋的巨大鸣叫。 一道肉眼可见的环形空气冲击波正面撞上机器人胸口。 在这一瞬间进入短暂慢动作：紫色机器人全身的机械锁扣依次弹开，车门护甲、车轮、玻璃、底盘和车身覆盖件在空中分离；金色竹知了从零件之间高速穿过，飞散的螺栓、灰尘和细小玻璃颗粒悬浮在阳光中。 这不是爆炸，也不是车辆被彻底摧毁。所有零件仍然属于同一辆紫色智界R7，没有火焰，没有人员受伤。 慢动作结束。 巨型机器人完全失去平衡，重重跪在停车场中央。它的机械结构迅速反向折叠：双腿收回底盘，车轮回到轮拱，车门重新闭合，车头、车顶和灯带准确复位。 伴随最后一声沉重的金属锁定声，机器人重新变回完整的紫色智界R7。 一片寂静。 车辆警报器逐渐停止。 顾客和销售人员小心翼翼地从展车后面探出头。一个销售人员迟疑地走向紫色R7，伸手摸了摸仍然发烫的引擎盖，又立刻把手缩了回来。 一个发光的竹知了缓缓落在美女肩膀上，光芒随即熄灭，重新变成普通竹制玩具。 她漫不经心地拍掉肩上的灰尘，收起细绳，经过已经恢复原状的紫色智界R7。 走出画面前，她回头看了一眼汽车，平静地小声说： “一千万以内最好玩的，还是这个。” 她再次转动竹知了，伴随着“呜哇、呜哇”的声音若无其事地继续向前走。 镜头没有切断，摄影者缓慢停下。画面最后同时保留她渐渐远去的背影、恢复原状的紫色智界R7，以及停车场后方鸿蒙智行·智界门店原有的门头标识。 严格限制 全片只有一个连续手持镜头；不航拍、不突然切换机位、不瞬移、不使用蒙太奇。美女、竹知了和紫色智界R7始终保持外观一致。只能有一辆R7变形，机器人所有零件均来自这辆车。 机器人必须具有真实重量、关节阻力、惯性和落地冲击，不能漂浮、瞬移或像橡胶玩具一样弯曲。竹知了群的运动必须有明确方向、空气阻力和碰撞反馈。 不出现驾驶员受伤、血液、人体撞击或真实人员死亡；不出现火灾与电池爆炸。不生成错误车型、乱码车标、额外手指、人物复制、车辆复制、卡通机器人、动漫光效、电子游戏HUD、字幕、贴纸、旁白、背景音乐或水印。现有门店标识自然入镜即可，不额外生成品牌宣传画面。

prompts.prompt: Create one 30-second 9:16 photorealistic live-action dramatic scene with five deliberate shots and native synchronized dialogue. Original characters: LENA: a 38-year-old South Asian woman, tired expressive eyes, dark wavy hair in a loose low bun, charcoal coat over a cream blouse. MOTHER: a 72-year-old South Asian woman with delicate features, silver hair in a loose braid and a pale-blue knitted cardigan. She has early dementia but remains emotionally perceptive. Setting: a quiet memory-care bedroom on a winter morning. Soft gray daylight enters from frame left; a warm bedside lamp provides gentle fill. Two chairs face each other beside the window. Subtle radiator ticks and distant corridor room tone. No music. Shot 1 — 0–6 seconds: Stable medium two-shot, natural 50mm perspective. Mother studies Lena politely without recognition and says warmly, “You’re very kind, nurse.” Lena hides the pain behind a small reassuring smile and answers, “I’m not a nurse, Mum. It’s Lena.” Shot 2 — 6–13 seconds: Cut to Mother’s close-up. Her eyes brighten at the memory of a child, not the woman before her. She says, “My Lena is eleven. She hates peas and lies badly.” Lena answers softly from offscreen, “She still does.” Mother’s smile disappears. She asks, genuinely wounded, “Then why doesn’t she come?” Shot 3 — 13–20 seconds: Cut to Lena’s close-up. Hold the frame. Her practiced smile fails; her lower lip tightens and her eyes begin filling, but she does not sob. After one difficult breath she says, “I come every Sunday. You just… keep losing me.” Shot 4 — 20–25 seconds: Cut back to Mother. She becomes briefly lucid. Her eyes remain fixed on Lena; one tear gathers without falling. In a quiet, fragile voice she says, “I don’t forget you. I just can’t find the way back.” Shot 5 — 25–30 seconds: Tighter two-shot. Lena leans slightly closer without touching her. Crying silently now, she smiles and says, “Then I’ll keep coming to find you.” Mother searches Lena’s face. Recognition slowly arrives through the eyes rather than a large expression. She takes a tiny breath and whispers, “Lena?” Hold their eye contact in complete silence for the final half-second. Performance: restrained natural acting. Begin emotionally guarded and let the pain accumulate. Tears must develop gradually, never appear at the beginning. Use breath catches, small eye movements, tightening facial muscles and pauses. No theatrical sobbing, head bobbing, repeated nodding or generic hand gestures. Only the assigned speaker’s lips move. The listener keeps their mouth closed and reacts through breathing, blinking and gaze. Preserve both identities, wardrobe, positions, eyelines, lighting and tear progression across every cut. Clear dry dialogue with realistic room perspective. No narration, subtitles, text, music, extra people, beauty filtering or skin smoothing.

prompts.prompt:
Super casual real smartphone home video footage, sunny Los Angeles backyard pool party with palm trees and string lights, natural mobile phone camera with slight authentic handheld shake, normal frame rate with smooth natural motion, rapidfire montage with constant quick jump cuts every 1-2 seconds like scrolling through phone memories, unpolished authentic phone recording of mixed ages swimming, eating and dancing near the pool, pure raw home video feel, no cinematic polish or heavy effects. Use the provided reference photo as the strict ONLY visual reference for the main woman. Maintain her exact appearance with zero deviation. Generate a mixed group of family and friends around her by the pool, palm trees, floats and drinks visible.
0-2.5s: Shaky rapid cuts main woman laughing near the pool edge, sunlight sparkling on water, quick flashes of friends splashing.
2.5-5s: Abrupt jump cuts close-up of her smiling with sunglasses, then friends passing cold drinks poolside.
5-7.5s: Fast shaky she chats animatedly on a lounge chair, pool floats and palm trees visible.
7.5-10s: Quick cut close-up cheerful smile toward camera, then jump to her laughing with family near the water.
10-12.5s: Abrupt edit group gathered around a poolside table, snacks shared, playful splashing in background.
12.5-15s: Fast rapid cuts she dances lightly near the pool, friends clapping and laughing along.
15-17.5s: Shaky jump cuts close-up of her jumping playfully near the water edge, laughter all around.
17.5-20s: Abrupt edit group taking a big splash together, mixed ages cheering happily.
20-22.5s: Fast shaky she relaxes on a float, chatting with a friend nearby, sunlight glowing.
22.5-25s: Quick cut close-up warm smile toward camera, then jump to her toasting drinks with friends. 25-27.5s: Abrupt edit everyone gathered close for a group moment, laughing near the pool.
27.5-30s: Final rapid transition main woman relaxed poolside with the group, soft smile, calm summer memory ending with slight natural phone sway. Natural smartphone video quality, slight real handheld shake, smooth normal frame rate motion with no low fps or choppy artifacts, authentic casual interactions and physics, stable main character consistency, charming unpolished home phone recording, no pro stabilization or effects.

prompts.prompt:
Duration: 10s | 9:16 | 24fps

[SUMMARY]
Five beautiful women in five countries greet the viewer on the same morning.
Each looks into the camera at selfie distance, says good morning in her native
language, then covers the lens with her palm — and the next country appears as
it pulls away.

[GLOBAL SETTINGS]
Early morning everywhere, soft low natural sunlight, warm and fresh.
Photorealistic, candid. 35mm, shallow depth of field, selfie distance, natural
film grain. No studio polish, no beauty filter, no skin smoothing.
Camera: chest-up close-up, locked off, eye level, one setup per beat — the
only movement is the woman and her hand.
Each woman is genuinely beautiful in the way her own country reads as
beautiful, but real: keep true fine pores and real skin texture, light natural
makeup or none. Genuine unforced brightness, not a posed smile. Every face
completely different from the other four.

[TRANSITION]
MASK TRANSITION at every cut: the palm advances toward the lens, fills and
blackens the frame, then pulls away to reveal the next woman already in place.
Prohibit hard cuts. Prohibit objects appearing out of thin air. Keep the
camera's breathing and timing in harmony, leaving enough time for each switch.

[TIMESTAMP STORYBOARD]

0-2s | JAPAN
25-year-old Japanese woman, elegant classical beauty. Cool-toned fair skin,
translucent, true fine pores. Slender double-eyelid almond eyes, cool clear
gaze, small straight nose, delicate jawline. Glossy jet-black hair past the
shoulders, curled softly inward, wispy see-through fringe. Cream ribbed knit
top. Slim shoulders, quiet grace.
By a bright bedroom window in Tokyo, white curtains behind her.
Her reserved face opens into a bright smile: 「おはよう！」
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

2-4s | UNITED STATES
25-year-old American woman, healthy open all-American beauty. Warm sun-kissed
skin with real freckles across nose and cheeks, true pores. Large round hazel
eyes creasing at the outer corners, high cheekbones, wide unguarded smile.
Voluminous honey-blonde beach waves gathered over one shoulder. Grey marl
sweatshirt slipping off one shoulder.
In a sunlit kitchen, a coffee mug on the counter behind her.
Brightly in English: "Good morning!"
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

4-6s | BRAZIL
25-year-old Brazilian woman, radiant sunlit beauty. Warm deep-brown skin with
a natural sheen, true pores. Large dark almond eyes, long thick lashes, high
cheekbones, full lips, broad open-mouthed smile. Abundant voluminous curls,
dark brown with caramel and honey highlights, wide around her shoulders. Small
gold hoops. Marigold-yellow strappy top.
On a balcony, tropical plants and morning haze behind her.
Brightly in Brazilian Portuguese: "Bom dia!"
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

6-8s | SPAIN
25-year-old Spanish woman, striking dark-eyed Mediterranean beauty. Olive
skin, warm and matte, true fine pores. Deep dark almond eyes under strong
brows, straight defined nose, sharp cheekbones, clean jawline, calm confident
half-smile that opens as she speaks. Long centre-parted deep-chestnut hair
with reddish warmth, thick and slightly wavy. Fine gold hoops. Crisp white
linen shirt, top button open. Upright poised posture.
In a whitewashed courtyard, terracotta pots and hard morning sun behind her.
Brightly in Spanish: "¡Buenos días!"
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

8-10s | INDONESIA
25-year-old Indonesian woman, warm sweet-featured beauty. Golden-brown skin,
smooth and luminous, true fine pores. Large round dark eyes, gentle open gaze,
softly rounded cheeks, small nose, wide easy smile that reaches her eyes.
Glossy very dark brown hair in a sharp chin-length blunt bob. Small gold
pendant. Sky-blue collared blouse. Petite, friendly.
On a wooden terrace, broad tropical leaves and soft morning light behind her.
Brightly in Indonesian: "Selamat pagi!"
She holds her smile and the frame ends on her face — she does NOT cover the
lens. The film finishes here.

[GLOBAL CLOSING]
Throughout: same chest-up framing, same eye-level camera height, same fresh
morning light, same warm mood in all five countries. Every woman looks
straight into the lens the whole time.
Five different faces, five different skin tones, five different hair colours
and lengths — jet-black long, honey-blonde waves, caramel curls, deep-chestnut
long, dark-brown bob. Never repeat a look, never blend two faces.
Each greeting is spoken clearly and completely within its two seconds, with
accurate native pronunciation and matching lip movement.
Pure video. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no BGM, no
watermark. Only the five voices and quiet morning room tone.
Prohibit: a sixth person, two people in one frame, the same face twice,
plastic or airbrushed skin, doll-like faces, hard cuts, objects appearing from
nothing, the hand entering before the greeting is finished, mixed camera
moves, jitter, flicker.

prompts.prompt:
CAMERA / LOOK: Handheld mini DV camcorder footage filmed by the subject herself. Slight hand shake, occasional focus hunting, imperfect framing, natural zoom adjustments, soft tape-like image quality, subtle grain, realistic auto-exposure shifts from bright natural daylight. Natural skin tones, mild motion blur, authentic consumer camcorder aesthetic.
STYLE: Cozy flower-pressing vlog with gentle ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, candid moments. Focus on satisfying sounds: petals rustling, paper pages turning, book weight settling, tweezers picking up petals, gentle smoothing.
SUBJECT: Young woman in her early 20s, plain linen dress, hair loose, minimal jewelry, no visible logos or branded items. Calm, gentle energy while preserving flowers.
SETTING: Small table near a window on a bright afternoon. Soft daylight, a plain heavy book, freshly picked flowers laid out, no visible brand names or packaging in frame.
STORYBOARD:
→ (3s, propped medium shot) Places camera on the table, lays out a few fresh flowers. "Pressing some flowers today."
→ (3s, overhead shot) Arranges petals flat between two sheets of plain paper.
→ (3s, close-up) Uses tweezers to gently position a delicate petal.
→ (3s, handheld shot) Closes the paper carefully over the flowers. "Just need to keep them flat."
→ (3s, detail shot) Places the paper between the pages of a heavy book. No dialogue.
→ (3s, medium shot) Stacks a few more books on top for weight. "That should do it."
→ (3s, macro shot) A previously pressed flower being lifted out, delicate and flat.
→ (3s, propped shot) Arranges the pressed flowers onto a small card.
→ (3s, warm ending shot) Admires the finished arrangement, soft smile. "So delicate and pretty."
→ (5s, final shot) Sets the card on the windowsill, reaches toward camera. "See you next batch." Hand covers lens as recording ends.
AUDIO NOTES: Natural ambience — petals rustling, paper turning, book settling should be clearly audible. Dialogue quiet and casual.
REALISM NOTES: Authentic body language, natural blinking, genuine soft smiles, occasional gentle pauses, imperfect framing, focus breathing, bright daylight shifts. No copyrighted characters, logos, brand names, or recognizable public figures anywhere in frame. Fully original personal vlog content, not AI-generated or commercial in style.

prompts.prompt: A cinematic 30-second tropical travel vlog montage featuring a beautiful 20-year-old East Asian woman with dark hair exploring Hawaii during a dreamy summer vacation. Shot like an authentic luxury travel diary with handheld camera movement, candid moments, soft golden-hour sunlight, dreamy 35mm film aesthetics, warm vintage color grading, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, atmospheric lighting, and cinematic storytelling. Maintain the same woman throughout every scene: dark hair, youthful appearance, natural makeup, elegant summer outfits, relaxed happy expression. Format: 4K cinematic video, 24fps, 35mm film grain, realistic handheld camera, soft focus, warm color palette, travel documentary style. Scene 1 (0-4s) — Arrival & City Walk: A beautiful Hawaiian morning. The woman walks through a bright tropical city street wearing a flowing floral summer dress and sunglasses. Palm trees line the sidewalk, sunlight reflects off colorful buildings, people walk casually in the background. Camera follows from behind, then transitions into a close-up of her smiling face as wind moves through her hair. Scene 2 (4-8s) — Beach Discovery: She steps onto a wide sandy beach with crystal blue ocean waves behind her. She walks barefoot along the shoreline, holding her dress slightly as waves touch her feet. Low-angle cinematic shots of footsteps in wet sand, ocean reflections, distant volcanic mountains under a clear sky. Scene 3 (8-12s) — Tropical Nature Moments: A cinematic worm's-eye view looking upward through towering palm trees. Golden sunlight streams between the leaves with beautiful lens flares. Cut to a close-up of her standing near a rocky ocean cliff, wind blowing through her hair while she looks peacefully toward the sea. Scene 4 (12-16s) — Beachfront Cafe & Slow Living: She sits alone at a cozy beachfront cafe near the window, drinking a tropical drink while watching waves outside. Soft sunlight enters through the glass. Close-up shots of her hands, coffee cup, ocean view, and thoughtful expression create an intimate travel diary feeling. Scene 5 (16-20s) — Ocean Adventure: She floats peacefully on a surfboard in calm turquoise ocean water. Camera moves around her from water level, showing gentle waves, sunlight sparkling on the sea surface, tropical coastline and mountains in the distance. She laughs naturally while looking toward the camera. Scene 6 (20-24s) — Night Market Exploration: A vibrant Hawaiian night market filled with warm lights, food stalls, and colorful decorations. She walks through the crowd, trying tropical fruit skewers and local street food. Cinematic close-ups of her reaction, glowing lanterns, neon bokeh, and bustling atmosphere. Scene 7 (24-27s) — Golden Sunset Ending: Wide cinematic silhouette shot of her standing on the ocean shore during sunset. Orange and pink skies reflect on the water. Waves gently move around her feet as she watches the sun disappear behind the horizon. Emotional travel film ending. Scene 8 (27-30s) — Hotel Night Reflection: Nighttime high-rise hotel balcony overlooking sparkling tropical city lights. She wears a simple white dress, leaning against the balcony while a warm breeze moves the curtains behind her. Final intimate close-up of her lying on the hotel bed, looking warmly into the camera lens with a peaceful smile. Camera Style: Authentic travel vlog cinematography, handheld camera shake, smooth cinematic transitions, slow push-ins, natural movement, occasional POV shots, realistic autofocus adjustments, subtle motion blur. Visual Style: Dreamy Hawaii vacation film, luxury travel advertisement aesthetic, soft golden sunlight, realistic skin texture, cinematic depth of field, nostalgic 35mm film look, warm atmospheric colors, natural expressions, emotional storytelling. Avoid: cartoon style, CGI look, plastic skin, unrealistic face, inconsistent character appearance, changing hairstyle, extra fingers, distorted body, artificial lighting, oversaturated colors, blurry face, unnatural movements, duplicate people.

prompts.prompt:
（元はThreadsのdopamin.wxyさんを参考にしています）

【Seedance 2.5／15秒／9:16】

参照画像を唯一のキャラクター参照として使用する。15秒、9:16縦型、ワンカット、固定カメラ。開始から終了までカメラは完全固定。ズーム、パン、チルト、回転、手持ち、カット、トランジション、リフレーム、スロー、静止演出は禁止。

【構図・立ち位置】

画面左側45％に実写のBBQグリルと骨付き肉を配置する。画面右側30％に2Dキャラクターを配置する。中央にはトングと肉を移動させるための空間を20％程度確保する。

キャラクターは右側の砂浜に立ち、頭から黒いビーチサンダルまで全身を常に表示する。キャラクターをグリルの前、グリル脚の上、テーブルの上には置かない。キャラクターとグリルの間には明確な空間を残し、開始から終了まで立ち位置を維持する。

グリル、肉、人の手、トング、コチュジャンボトルをキャラクターの身体と重ねない。キャラクターが肉やグリルを隠さない。人の手やトングがキャラクターの顔や身体を不自然に横切らない。物体同士の奥行きと前後関係を正確に維持する。

【映像スタイル】

真夏の美しい海辺で行われる実写BBQ映像と、平面2Dアニメーションステッカーキャラクターを組み合わせたコミカルな映像。

青い海、白い波、明るい青空、黄金色の砂浜、遠景の海岸線、風に揺れるヤシの葉を描く。明るい昼の自然光。海風によってヤシの葉、グリルの煙、キャラクターの白いシャツの裾が自然に揺れる。

背景、海、砂、グリル、炭火、煙、炎、骨付き肉、脂、肉汁、コチュジャン、ボトル、人の手、金属トングはすべて高品質な実写表現。白飛び、過度なブルーム、霞、露出のちらつきは禁止。

キャラクターだけは最後まで平面2Dアニメーションステッカーとして維持する。実写化、半実写化、3D化、CGフィギュア化、ゲームモデル化、Pixar風、クレイアニメ風は禁止。鮮明な線画、セル塗り、平面的な陰影、細い白フチを維持する。

【キャラクター固定】

参照画像の男性キャラクターをそのまま使用する。柔らかなアッシュシルバーのウェーブヘア、前髪の形、髪の長さと毛量、灰青色の瞳、若く整った顔、細身で長い手足の体型を固定する。

白いノースリーブインナー、透け感のある白い半袖オープンシャツ、白いドローコード、黒いペイズリー柄ショートパンツ、黒いビーチサンダル、シルバーネックレス、ピアス、ブレスレット、リングを固定する。

顔、髪型、体型、衣装、柄、色、靴、アクセサリーを変更しない。帽子、サングラス、エプロン、手袋、新しい小物を追加しない。キャラクターを複製しない。別の2Dキャラクターを追加しない。

キャラクターは冷たい無表情ではなく、非常に可愛く表情豊かに動く。大きく輝く目、頬の赤み、嬉しそうな笑顔、首を傾げる仕草、肩を小さく揺らす動き、頬を膨らませた拗ね顔、涙目、慌てて手を振る動きを明確に見せる。棒立ち禁止。

【BBQと骨付き肉】

画面左側の実写BBQグリルで、大きな骨付きトマホークステーキを焼く。長い骨が肉に物理的につながったまま明確に見える。肉は十分に焼けており、濃い焼き目、香ばしい焦げ目、艶のある肉汁、溶けた脂、軽い湯気を描く。

肉を生肉、黒焦げ、骨なし肉、変形した肉にしない。肉や骨を複製しない。骨を途中で消さない。

実写の成人女性の手が画面左端から入る。ピンク色のネイルアート、細いシルバーリング、正常な5本指を維持する。金属製BBQトングで肉を返し、持ち上げる。手、指、リング、トング、肉、グリルを融合させない。

【コチュジャン】

ラベル、文字、ブランドロゴのない透明なスクイーズボトルを使用する。中身は濃厚で艶のある深い赤茶色のコチュジャン。ケチャップのような明るい赤色や水っぽい液体にはしない。

コチュジャンはボトルのノズルから太く連続して流れ、肉の表面に直接落ちる。ソースを空中から突然出現させない。ボトルの底や側面から漏らさない。

【00:00–00:03】

固定されたワイド構図で開始する。左側では骨付きトマホークステーキが大きな音を立てて焼けている。女性の実写の手が金属トングで肉を一度ゆっくり返す。脂が炭に落ち、小さな炎が一瞬だけ上がる。薄い煙が海風に流れる。

右側の2Dキャラクターは肉を見つめ、目を大きくキラキラ輝かせる。両手を顎の下で合わせ、肩を上げ、膝を少し曲げて小さく2回弾む。口元に小さな2Dのよだれが一滴だけ現れて消える。

【00:03–00:05】

キャラクターがコチュジャンボトルを見つける。目を輝かせ、首を傾げ、片手でボトルを指さす。嬉しそうにボトルを両手で持ち、胸の前で一瞬だけ抱き締める。

その後、片目を閉じたイタズラっぽい笑顔になり、ノズルを左側の肉へ向ける。キャラクター自身は右側の立ち位置から移動しない。

【00:05–00:07】

キャラクターがボトルを強く絞り、骨付き肉の上へコチュジャンを大量にかける。濃い赤茶色の太いソースがノズルから肉まで連続して伸び、肉の表面に大量のジグザグ模様を作る。

ソースは熱で軽く泡立ち、肉汁と混ざって艶を出す。肉全体を完全に隠さず、骨と焼き目は見える状態を維持する。

キャラクターは得意げに笑い、舌先を少し出し、肩を可愛く左右に揺らしながらボトルを絞る。女性の手はトングを持ったまま驚いて止まる。

【00:07–00:09】

女性の手がトングでコチュジャンボトルを素早く取り上げ、左側へ戻す。その直後、閉じたトングの先端でキャラクターの頭頂部を軽く一度だけ「こん！」と叩く。

トングの先端がキャラクターの髪へ明確に軽く接触する。接触と同時に、頭の上へ小さな黄色い2Dの星形衝撃エフェクトを出す。強く殴らない。痛々しくしない。完全に可愛いカートゥーン式のツッコミにする。

叩かれた瞬間、キャラクターの頭が右へ傾き、銀髪が弾み、肩と胴体が左、右へ大きく揺れる。膝が曲がり、両腕を広げてバランスを取る。足は砂浜から離れず、グリル側へ移動しない。

頬を膨らませ、目をぎゅっと閉じ、小さな涙を一滴だけ出す。頭だけではなく、全身が可愛く揺れる動きを約1秒間はっきり見せる。

【00:09–00:11】

女性の手がトングをグリルへ戻し、コチュジャンの付いた焼き肉を一口サイズに持ち上げる。持ち上げた肉には焼き目、肉汁、繊維、濃いコチュジャンが見える。

トングは中央の空間を通り、肉をキャラクターの口の前まで運ぶ。キャラクターは頭を叩かれたことに拗ね、腕を組んで顔を横へ向け、頬を膨らませる。

すぐに目だけで肉をちらっと見る。目が再び輝き、腕をほどき、両手を背中へ回し、上半身を少し前へ傾ける。口を大きく開け、肉へ近づく。

【00:11–00:12】

キャラクターが肉を明確に一口食べる。開いた口をトングで持った肉へ近づけ、肉を口で挟み、頭を後ろへ引いて一口分を噛み取る。

トングに残った肉には、はっきりした一口分の欠けた跡を残す。肉を見るだけ、匂いを嗅ぐだけ、舐めるだけは禁止。

キャラクターは2回はっきり噛む。頬を少し膨らませ、最初は非常に幸せそうな表情になる。目を閉じ、両手を頬へ当て、片足のかかとを上げて嬉しそうに小さく揺れる。

【00:12–00:13.2】

突然、激辛に気づく。噛む動きを止め、目を大きな丸に見開き、瞳孔を小さくする。顔全体が頬から額まで急速に赤くなる。頭の周囲に小さな汗マークを複数出す。

両手で口元を高速にあおぎ、左右の足を交互に小さく上げて慌てる。膝、肩、胴体を細かく震わせ、両目に大きな可愛い涙をためる。右側の立ち位置から出ない。

【00:13.2–00:14.4】

キャラクターが上半身を少し前へ倒し、口を大きく開ける。口の中から、明確な平面2Dコミック炎を一度だけ勢いよく吹き出す。

炎はキャラクターの口から始まり、画面右上の何もない空間へ向かう。炎をグリル、肉、人の手、トング、ボトルへ向けない。

炎は黄色い中心、オレンジ色の本体、赤い輪郭を持つ平面2Dイラスト。炎の中に小さな赤唐辛子マークを数個混ぜる。実写の危険な炎にはしない。物を燃やさない。爆発させない。

キャラクターは涙を流しながら両腕を慌てて振り、炎の反動で上半身だけ少し後ろへ揺れる。足は砂浜の同じ位置を維持する。

【00:14.4–00:15】

2Dの炎が小さく縮み、可愛い白い煙の「ぷすっ」という一粒のエフェクトに変わる。

キャラクターは最後に全身を一度だけ左右へふらつかせる。膝が震え、肩が落ち、髪が一度弾む。両手で口を押さえ、真っ赤な頬、涙目、腫れたような小さな唇、恥ずかしそうな表情になる。

頭の上を小さな赤唐辛子アイコンが回転する。女性の手は左側で、一口分が欠けた肉をトングで持ったまま困惑して停止する。

キャラクター全身は右側、グリルと肉は左側に明確に分離した状態で終了する。フェードアウト禁止。タイトル表示禁止。

【音】

海の波音、海風、ヤシの葉の揺れる音、遠くの鳥の声、炭火の音、肉の強い焼ける音、脂が落ちる小さな炎の音、コチュジャンを絞る音、軽いコミカル音、頭を叩く明確な「こん！」という音、全身が揺れる弾む音、一口噛む音、2回の咀嚼音、激辛に気づく上昇音、可愛いコミック炎の「ボワッ」という音、最後の小さな「ぷすっ」という煙の音。

明るく可愛いテンポのBGMを小さく流す。台詞、ナレーション、歌声、字幕、テロップ、歌詞、画面内文字は禁止。

【禁止事項】

キャラクターとグリルの重なり禁止。キャラクターをグリル脚の上へ立たせない。肉をキャラクターで隠さない。人の手やボトルでキャラクターを隠さない。トングをキャラクターの身体へ貫通させない。前後関係の崩壊禁止。

頭を叩く動作の省略禁止。全身が揺れる動作の省略禁止。一口食べる動作の省略禁止。肉の一口跡の省略禁止。咀嚼の省略禁止。激辛リアクションの省略禁止。口から炎を吹く動作の省略禁止。

カメラ移動禁止。カット禁止。画面転換禁止。スロー禁止。静止画化禁止。キャラクターの棒立ち禁止。キャラクター複製禁止。顔変化禁止。髪型変化禁止。衣装変化禁止。足の消失禁止。全身のクロップ禁止。実写化禁止。3D化禁止。

手の変形、指の増減、トングとの融合、物体の浮遊、ボトルの消失、ソースの空中発生、ケチャップ化、生肉化、骨なし肉化、骨の分離、肉の複製、危険な実写炎、火傷、爆発、ブランド、ロゴ、字幕、白飛び、ちらつきを禁止する。

prompts.prompt:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself throughout each location, occasionally propped briefly for hands-free moments. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.
LOOK:
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones — lighting shifts per location (clinical soft light at physio → warm home light for stretching → soft steamy bathroom light → dim cozy bedroom light).
STYLE:
Slow, gentle montage feel — calmer and more tender than her usual bubbly vlogs. Quiet reflective voiceover narration plays over the visuals instead of synced dialogue. Mood stays soft and caring throughout, centered on rest and self-care.
Character
CHASE — Korean idol, 20s. Long straight black hair, natural and softly tied back, dewy glass skin, minimal to no makeup, tired but peaceful expression. Wearing a modest robe or oversized loungewear throughout — fully covering arms, torso, and legs at all times, including during the bath/shower segment (framed only from shoulders up or via steam/robe coverage, nothing revealing shown).
Setting Progression
Physio/massage clinic (afternoon) → her room, stretching mat (early evening) → bathroom, steamy warm light (night) → bedroom (late night).
Storyboard (20s, 6 cuts)
(~3.5s, physio clinic, propped camera, medium shot) She lies on a treatment table as a therapist's hands (off-camera) work on her shoulder, wincing slightly then relaxing. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Some days, taking care of myself has to come first."
(~3s, physio clinic, close handheld) She sits up slowly afterward, rolling her shoulder, small relieved exhale. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "That already feels so much better."
(~3.5s, home, stretching mat, medium propped shot) She stretches gently on a mat in her room, slow and unhurried, soft evening light. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "A little more stretching never hurts."
(~3s, bathroom, steamy soft light, framed modestly — shoulders up only, robe visible) She sits wrapped in a robe near a warm bath or shower, steam softly filling the frame, eyes closed peacefully. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "And then... just letting the day melt away."
(~3s, bathroom, macro insert) Close-up on water droplets and steam, soft warm light, no exposed skin beyond hands/face. No narration — ambient water sound only.
(~4s, bedroom, dim cozy light, closing shot) She climbs into bed early, pulling the blanket up, eyes already heavy, a small content smile before the screen fades. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Some nights, the earlier the better."

The camera rapidly pans out through the slit into a super wide fisheye low-angle perspective looking up at two young men standing in a glowing Tokyo street corner at night surrounded by tall neon skyscrapers under dark skies. 2 to 4 seconds: Quick handheld whip-pan to the right down a neon lit sidewalk. A young black man with braided hair wearing a bright royal blue sweater with yellow lettering and a green paisley scarf steps casually through the frame while gesturing at the camera. Fast rotational motion blur transition sweeps across the screen. 4 to 6 seconds: Scene cuts smoothly inside a bright Japanese claw machine arcade filled with pastel pink interior walls and fluorescent overhead lights. The camera tracks backward as the young man in the blue sweater walks forward holding a small pink object to his ear while smiling and talking. An animated stylized liquid frame graphic swirls briefly around the edges of the frame. 6 to 8 seconds: Seamless cut to a retro mint green fast-food diner booth with warm overhead hanging lamp lighting. Low-angle wide view on the white tabletop as the man in the blue sweater reaches his hand directly toward the camera glass offering food. A quick dynamic psychedelic thermal infrared visual effect flashes over the screen for half a second showing vivid heat map colors of red, neon green, and deep blue before snapping back to real life. 8 to 10 seconds: The second man wearing the black jacket suddenly pops up from the diner table with an energetic reaction, holding a drink cup as the camera sweeps low. Fast cut to outdoors on a night street where both men walk along the pavement and high five each other in motion under glowing urban shop signs. 10 to 13 seconds: Camera drops to an extreme ground-level fisheye lens pointing straight up from the asphalt of a narrow alleyway. Both men loom over the lens under vertical glowing Japanese neon signboards. One subject stoops down and reaches his palm directly over the camera lens, causing a rapid spinning rotational motion blur that wipes the screen to black. Visual details: Authentic analog film grain, natural subtle lens distortion, realistic handheld camera shake, rich contrasty neon lighting, crisp reflections on pavement, high energy streetwear styling, realistic 90s hip hop music video camera direction. Audio includes an upbeat boom bap 90s hip hop beat with heavy bass, classic vinyl scratches, energetic vocal chops, synth accents, dynamic street ambiance, arcade sound effects, and clean rhythmic percussion layered throughout.

Cozy sunlit laundry nook with an open front-load washer, overflowing basket, wooden drying rack, clothespins, and warm sunlight. She is the only person in the video.

Sequence: untangles wet clothes → shakes out a shirt → checks a collar stain by the window → hangs it saying "Good enough." → finds a mismatched sock → struggles with a heavy bedsheet while laughing → finishes hanging it and quietly admires the sunlit laundry.

Dialogue is natural spoken Korean (except "Good enough"), reacting casually to each moment. Ambient sound only: washer winding down, wet fabric, clothespins, rustling clothes, soft laughter, breeze. prompts.prompt: Create a ten second cinematic live action illusion in a sixteen by nine frame at thirty frames per second. Begin inside a faithfully recreated late nineteen nineties desktop paint program. Use a cool gray window frame, navy title bar, simple menus, chunky pixel tool icons on the left, scroll bars, and small color swatches along the bottom. The canvas shows a saturated blue sky with soft white clouds and a vivid green grassy hill, nostalgic but photographed with realistic depth, subtle cloud movement, and light atmospheric haze. 0 to 1.2 seconds. Hold a locked frontal camera on the full paint window. The empty landscape fills the canvas. A slim young adult man rises smoothly from the bottom center with his back to camera. He wears a red athletic shirt with white collar and sleeve stripes, a backward royal blue cap, a thin silver chain, and black ink forearm tattoos. Give his movement real body weight, natural shoulder motion, and slight cloth drag. 1.2 to 2.5 seconds. He lifts his tattooed right arm toward the upper left of the canvas as though touching an invisible drawing tool. Keep the interface perfectly stable and sharp. He turns clockwise toward camera, lowers his hand, and settles into a relaxed waist up pose at center. Use soft frontal daylight, a gentle key from camera left, believable skin texture, clear eyes, fine facial hair, and a faint contact shadow. 2.5 to 6.2 seconds. He looks into camera with a playful calm expression, raises one index finger, and draws in midair. A warm ivory line appears exactly at the fingertip and follows every gesture without delay. It looks like a real textured paint stroke with slight thickness variation, dry brush edges, and a soft glow. He draws one continuous five point star around his body. Make the tall upper point above his cap, the right point beside his shoulder, the lower left point across his torso, the lower right point, then close the shape near his raised hand. Preserve correct hand anatomy, stable identity, perfect line continuity, and natural reactions from his free hand. 6.2 to 7.4 seconds. When the star closes, perform a smooth optical push into the canvas until the interface edges slide beyond the frame. The move should feel like a real camera passing through a monitor, with subtle lens breathing and no cut. He smiles softly and lifts both palms in a small satisfied reveal while the completed ivory star floats around him. 7.4 to 10 seconds. He glances right and walks naturally out of frame. Keep the camera locked on the empty hill and sky. The star remains suspended, slowly loses brightness, and becomes slightly transparent without vanishing. End with one cloud drifting through its center. Maintain one continuous shot, realistic motion blur, natural blinking, stable clothing and tattoos, accurate perspective, clean edges, no warped limbs, no duplicate fingers, no facial changes, no flicker, no random objects, no extra people, and no artificial plastic skin. Make it feel like a practical live action performance composited into an authentic retro computer interface. Audio. Add an original playful retro electronic instrumental at about one hundred and five beats per minute with a warm drum machine groove, soft bass, bright synth plucks, and subtle digital ambience. Sync a light mouse click to the first hand gesture, delicate paint stroke swishes to the fingertip, a sparkling chime when the star closes, and a soft whoosh during the push into the canvas. No vocals and no dialogue.

prompts.prompt: Once upon a time there lived a hare. The hare could run very fast. It was proud of its speed, One day, the hare saw a tortoise walking very slowly. So the hare and the tortoise had a race. The hare ran very fast and very far. Then it turned back to see where the tortoise was. The tortoise was far behind the hare. It was walking so slowly!The proud hare thought, “The tortoise will take a very long time to come near me. Let me have a nap.” So it stopped running and went to sleep The tortoise slowly but steadily went past the hare. The hare suddenly woke up and saw the tortoise just crossing the finishing line. It started running very fast. But it was too late. The tortoise had already won the race. a fun 3d pixar style family animation

prompts.prompt:
CAMERA / LOOK: Handheld mini DV camcorder footage filmed by the subject herself. Slight hand shake, occasional focus hunting, imperfect framing, natural zoom adjustments, soft tape-like image quality, subtle grain, realistic auto-exposure shifts from bright open-sky daylight. Natural skin tones, mild motion blur, authentic consumer camcorder aesthetic rather than polished cinematic footage.
STYLE: Cozy outdoor kite-flying vlog with gentle ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, candid moments, natural pauses. Focus on satisfying everyday sounds: kite fabric flapping in the wind, string spool unwinding, grass rustling underfoot, light breeze against the microphone.
SUBJECT: Young woman in her mid-20s, plain windbreaker, hair tied back in a loose ponytail, minimal jewelry, no visible logos or branded items. Cheerful, carefree energy on a breezy afternoon.
SETTING: Small open field on a bright breezy afternoon. Wide open sky, plain grass field, no visible signage, buildings with branding, or logos anywhere in frame.
STORYBOARD:
→ (3s, propped medium shot) Places camera on a low tripod in the grass, unrolls a plain kite. "Perfect windy day for this."
→ (3s, overhead shot) Unwinds the string spool, checking it's free of tangles.
→ (3s, close-up) Attaches the string firmly to the kite frame.
→ (3s, handheld shot) Walks backward a few steps, testing the wind direction. "Feels strong enough today."
→ (3s, detail shot) Releases the kite gently into the air. No dialogue.
→ (3s, medium shot) Watches it climb higher, letting the string out slowly. "There it goes."
→ (3s, macro shot) Kite fabric flapping steadily against the open sky.
→ (3s, propped shot) Sits down on the grass, holding the string loosely.
→ (3s, warm ending shot) Looks up at the kite soaring, happy smile. "Love days like this."
→ (5s, final shot) Reels the string in slowly, glances toward camera. "See you next time." Reaches down and covers the lens as recording ends.
AUDIO NOTES: Natural outdoor ambience — kite flapping, string unwinding, breeze, grass rustling should be clearly audible. Dialogue quiet and casual, as if speaking to a small personal audience.
REALISM NOTES: Authentic body language, natural blinking, genuine cheerful smiles, occasional pauses adjusting the string, imperfect framing, focus breathing, bright open-sky lighting shifts. No copyrighted characters, logos, brand names, or recognizable public figures anywhere in frame. Fully original personal vlog content, not AI-generated or commercial in style.

prompts.prompt:
【写实前缀】 超写实史诗电影影像，21:9超宽银幕，中国投掷武器、火器与飞行科技从远古时代一路进化到星际时代。整段采用受控多镜头匹配剪辑，每次切换都保持飞行主体的中心位置、轮廓方向、旋转角度、运动速度和整体动量连续。 低饱和、高对比、真实材质、自然运动模糊。飞行物始终清晰锐利，背景因高速移动形成纵深模糊。历史环境从荒凉远古平原，依次升级为商周、秦汉、宋代、明代、现代山谷、近地轨道与未来深空。中国文化元素随时代自然出现，不使用文字介绍。 【正片】 第一画面已经出现一名年轻中国古代侍女
穿着
HKb7_rmbMAARNAP
站在荒凉平原的画面右侧，身体朝向画面左侧。她五官秀美清晰， 远方是低矮山脉、枯草、裸露岩石和灰蓝色阴云。女侠神情凌厉，右脚踩实地面，左脚向前稳定重心，腰部向后扭转，肩膀带动右臂，以全身力量将一块粗糙灰色石块猛力抛向画面左侧。发尾、衣摆和腰间束带受到转身惯性向外甩动。 摄影机立即追上飞行的石块。石块位于画面中心，占画面高度约三分之一，一边高速前进一边不规则旋转。摄影机与石块保持约一米距离同步伴飞，背景荒原快速向后退去，女侠在浅景深中迅速缩小。 MATCH CUT。 石块在旋转至相同角度的瞬间，变成一把原始石槌：灰色钝石通过粗糙植物纤维牢牢捆绑在木柄前端。石槌保持完全相同的中心位置、飞行方向和旋转速度，木柄因高速旋转产生自然拖影。背景出现远古部落、木制栅栏、兽皮帐篷和稀疏火堆。 MATCH CUT。 石槌变成一支商周时期的青铜长矛。矛头具有厚重的青铜质感、铸造纹理和自然氧化斑，木质矛杆继续沿同一轨迹高速飞行。背景升级为尘土飞扬的早期古代战场，远处可见战车、木盾、皮甲士兵和迎风摆动的素色旌旗。 MATCH CUT。 青铜长矛变成一支秦汉重弩射出的弩箭。弩箭具有锋利的三棱青铜箭头、硬木箭杆和稳定尾羽，主体仍位于画面中心。背景升级为秦汉边塞，夯土城墙、木制箭楼、弩阵和远处骑兵在冷灰色风沙中快速掠过。箭杆高速自旋，尾羽受到气流产生细小颤动。 MATCH CUT。 弩箭变成一支宋代火箭矢。箭杆前端保留金属箭头，中段捆绑细长火药筒，尾部喷出明亮橙色火焰与灰白烟迹。火箭矢保持此前弩箭的飞行方向和旋转轴，火焰只在尾部向后喷射，不改变主体轨迹。 背景升级为宋代城防战场，青砖城墙、木制楼橹、床弩、盾阵和瓦顶建筑在浓烟中快速后退。火药燃烧照亮箭杆边缘，烟迹被高速气流拉成长线。 MATCH CUT。 火箭矢前端在经过画面中心时变成一枚宋代震天雷。震天雷是一枚沉重的深灰色球形铁壳火器，表面具有铸铁纹理、接缝和短小燃烧引线。它继续沿同一轨迹高速旋转，燃烧引线向后拉出火星，没有提前爆炸。 背景中的宋代城墙发生远距离爆炸，橙黄色火球、碎土和烟尘形成冲击波。逆光在震天雷边缘形成短促金属高光，主体依然保持锐利。 MATCH CUT。 球形震天雷在旋转遮挡中变成一具明代神火飞鸦。神火飞鸦具有写实的乌鸦形木质外壳、黑色蒙皮、两侧短翼和尾部火箭推进器，不是活鸟。它沿同一方向飞行，尾部数道橙红火焰同时喷射，短翼受到气流产生轻微震动。 背景升级为明代大型城防战场，砖石城楼、火器营、成排火箭架、黑色火药烟雾和迎风摆动的军旗快速掠过。神火飞鸦从传统火器形态逐渐展现出早期飞行器轮廓。 MATCH CUT。 神火飞鸦张开的黑色双翼变成一架银灰色三角翼隐形战斗机。摄影机位于战机前上方约十米处高速后退引导，战机保持画面中心，贴近东方山谷高速俯冲。 下方是云雾笼罩的喀斯特峰林、河流和层叠山脊。战机表面采用克制的深灰色隐身涂层和东方几何分割线，没有文字、编号或标志。机翼切开湿润空气，翼尖形成短暂白色凝结涡，峡谷后方升起浓黑烟柱。 MATCH CUT。 战斗机变成一架白色可重复使用载人航天器。机首倾角、三角翼轮廓和运动方向保持一致，机腹覆盖深色耐热材料，机身具有红色细节线和真实隔热板结构，不出现旗帜、文字或机构标志。 航天器尾部喷射巨大的橙蓝色火焰，冲破云层进入近地轨道。背景从东方山脉自然过渡为大气层边缘，地球蓝色弧线出现在画面下方，阳光在白色机身边缘形成冷白高光。 MATCH CUT。 航天器尾焰中心变成未来东方星际飞船的巨大圆形推进器。推进器内部的同心金属环、耐热陶瓷和磁约束结构逐层亮起橙红色能量。摄影机继续高速后退，飞船正面和完整船体逐渐显露。 星际飞船采用厚重可信的工业结构，主体为深灰金属、玉白色陶瓷装甲和暗红色结构线。船体轮廓具有克制的中式轴线对称、飞檐折线和龙脊般的纵向结构，但不是宫殿、宝塔或卡通龙造型。装甲表面分布细密机械舱门、散热片、微弱红色状态灯和若隐若现的抽象云纹压印。 摄影机贴近飞船外壳掠过船体顶部。大型装甲板、结构梁和散热格栅从镜头下方高速通过，运动方向始终连续。摄影机随后越过船体中轴，自然进入飞船后方视角。 最终画面中，巨型东方星际飞船尾部位于画面中心，多组圆形蓝白色离子引擎由内向外依次点火。发动机亮度迅速增强，冷蓝光反射在玉白陶瓷与深灰金属装甲表面。 飞船产生明确加速度，带着巨大质量感驶向深空。摄影机逐渐停止追随，飞船越来越小，最终缩成远方红蓝星云前的一颗明亮光点。星际飞船消失后，星云轮廓短暂呈现出类似水墨山脉的自然层次，但仍保持真实宇宙影像质感。 【摄影与物理】 飞行物镜头使用29°至47°对角视场角，摄影机与主体保持稳定伴飞距离。主体始终位于画面中心并保持锐利，背景保留高速运动模糊和清楚的时代环境线索。 每种物体具有正确质量、惯性、空气阻力、旋转轴和材质反光：石块旋转不规则；石槌受木柄影响产生偏心旋转；长矛与弩箭沿长轴稳定；震天雷沉重且旋转较慢；神火飞鸦依靠尾部火箭保持姿态；战机、航天器和星际飞船依靠气动面或推进系统稳定飞行。 匹配剪辑只发生在主体经过画面中心、轮廓短暂重叠或旋转至相同角度的瞬间。每次变化都是干净利落的一帧MATCH CUT，不是渐变、融化或零件生长。飞行方向、视觉中心和总体动量始终连续。 【声音】 只生成画面内自然音效：女侠发力时的短促呼气、鞋底摩擦、衣料与发带破风声、手臂挥动声、石块和石槌划破空气的呼啸、青铜矛头的低沉风鸣、弩箭尾羽振动、火箭矢燃烧声、震天雷引线火花、远处爆炸、神火飞鸦火箭喷射、战斗机喷气发动机、航天器推进器轰鸣，以及星际引擎逐级充能和点火声。 声音随时代升级逐渐由原始风声和金属声，发展为火药爆燃、喷气轰鸣和深沉的星际推进器低频震动。无旁白、无对白、无背景音乐。 【写实后缀】 真实电影级运动物理，细腻材质，稳定主体一致性，准确匹配剪辑，真实景深和速度模糊。中国古代女侠面部自然真实，身体结构正确，投掷动作具有明确的脚步支撑、腰部扭转、肩臂传力和释放惯性。 禁止古代女侠变脸、手指异常、服装穿模或宽大袖子缠绕手臂；禁止武器漂浮、橡胶变形、突然减速、反向飞行或改变轨迹；禁止渐变变形、粒子重组和魔法光效；禁止把神火飞鸦生成真实乌鸦；禁止把星际飞船生成宫殿、宝塔或卡通巨龙。 画面内不出现文字、字幕、标志、水印或UI。各时代环境连续升级，飞行主体的方向、视觉中心、旋转节奏和动量始终保持一致。

prompts.prompt:
30-second cinematic historical epic, 16:9. Photorealistic late Egyptian royal court with grounded human behavior, real skin texture, natural facial micro-expressions, historically inspired linen, bronze, gold, leather, horses, papyrus, firelight and stone. Preserve the queen in ivory and deep-blue gown, the kneeling Roman envoy in dark red cloak and bronze armor, the emerald-robed priestess, the enormous blue-and-gold throne hall, burning braziers, reflective black floor, and the Nile beyond the open arches.

0-5s: [Slow low dolly from behind the kneeling Roman envoy toward the queen] The queen studies the Roman treaty in silence. Firelight flickers across her face; the envoy's hands are tense around the ivory tablet. Behind the throne, Egyptian palace guards stand still with bronze spears and large blue-and-gold shields.
Envoy, restrained English: “Rome offers peace.”

5-10s: [Medium close-up on the queen] She looks up slowly. Her expression is calm, intelligent, and cold rather than theatrical.
Queen, clear English: “Rome offers surrender.”
The envoy swallows, briefly losing his composure.

10-15s: [Over-the-shoulder on the envoy, queen in focus behind him] He glances toward the open Nile archway.
Envoy: “Their legions wait at the river.”
The priestess watches the queen closely; only the flames and curtains move.

15-21s: [Camera tracks alongside the queen as she rises and descends the throne steps] The queen hands the treaty to the priestess, who drops it into a bronze brazier. The papyrus burns naturally. The queen walks forward, her heavy blue train sliding across the black stone floor. Palace guards step apart in two disciplined lines, creating a path toward the open terrace. No magical effects, only fire, smoke, fabric, metal, and human tension.

21-26s: [Camera follows behind her, then cranes upward over her shoulder] She reaches the vast palace terrace overlooking the Nile. Below, a real Egyptian royal army fills the riverbank and courtyard: rows of bronze-armored infantry, tall standards moving in hot wind, horse-drawn chariots, shield-bearing guards, priests carrying gold sun emblems, and long riverboats waiting beside the water. Dust hangs in the warm dawn light. The scale is enormous but physically believable.

26-30s: [Low-angle close-up, army blurred behind her] The queen stops at the terrace edge. Wind lifts the edge of her blue train. She looks toward the Roman envoy, then toward her assembled army.
Queen, low and final: “Then Rome will learn whom Egypt follows.”
Hold on her face as the army below strikes spear shafts once against their shields in a single thunderous response.

Grand historical scale, grounded realism, emotionally restrained acting, physically accurate crowd movement, detailed bronze armor, natural fire and smoke, believable horse and chariot motion, rich blue, gold, ivory and desert-stone palette, elegant stable camera movement, precise English lip sync. No magic, no supernatural symbols, no modern objects, no sci-fi effects, no random text, no logos, no extra main characters, no duplicate limbs, no warped faces or hands, no costume drift, no unstable architecture, no chaotic camera shake.
